newsitem.title: USA: Wackenhut says forms new unit, buys hospital.
newsitem.headline: Wackenhut says forms new unit, buys hospital.

text.p: Wackenhut Corrections said Thursday it has formed a wholly owned subsidiary called Atlantic Shores Healthcare Inc, and has agreed to buy a private hospital as its initial operating unit.
The company said it is buying the Coral Ridge Psychiatric Hospital in Fort Lauderdale, Fla. for about $6.5 million.
The company said the deal is expected to be completed within a month. The hospital will be renamed Atlantic Shores Hospital.
The company said it plans to spend $1 million upgrading the hosspital, which is licensed for 86 beds.
